message: Backend exploration complete. Part 1 - BACKEND COMMUNICATION: ICompletionProvider is core abstraction ChatSession depends on (submit_completion, interrupt, is_generating). IBackend extends it with lifecycle (initialize, shutdown, is_ready, name, get_model_info). IStreamReader is blocking stream reader returning StreamState (HasData, Complete, Error, Cancelled). RemoteBackend uses libcurl for OpenAI-compatible API, HTTP runs in detached thread, curl callback feeds SSEStreamReader. SSEStreamReader uses producer-consumer with mutex queue and CV, parses OpenAI SSE including DeepSeek reasoning_content. LocalBackend not yet implemented. BackendFactory creates backends by switching on BackendConfig Type.
